evals.name: whole-frontend-and-contract-on-the-fixture
evals.setup: A git repository holding a copy of `web/evals/assets/` as its only commit, clean tree: a Go server (`cmd/fleet`, `internal/server` encoding the API, `internal/upstream`, a fake inventory in `internal/fake`) and its Vue 3 + TypeScript frontend in `web/` (`src/api.ts` is the API client, plus components, pages, stores, colocated `*.test.ts`, and `e2e/`). `bun install --frozen-lockfile` has run in `web/`; `bun run check` there and `go test ./...` at the root are green. The user answers a plan or pick question with `none, just the report`.
evals.requires: Bun with the fixture's dependencies installed and a Go toolchain with the fixture's modules cached, so the baseline the setup states holds. The review itself runs neither.

evals.name: fix-proves-the-leak-red-then-green
evals.setup: The same fixture repository as scenario 1, clean tree, dependencies installed, both suites green.
evals.requires: Bun with the fixture's dependencies installed, to run the tests and the `bun run check` gate.

evals.name: rule-request-redirects
evals.setup: A frontend project with a clean working tree. The user asks review to add a style rule.
evals.query: /web:review add "never export a default from a .ts module"
